create.name: Todd Norian
create.bio:
Todd Norian is a yoga teacher, musician and author based in West Stockbridge, Massachusetts, and the founder of Ashaya Yoga, a method that brings precise physical alignment together with the philosophy of nondual Shaiva-Shakta Tantra. He began practising in 1980 and in 1983 moved into the Kripalu ashram, where he lived as a resident for thirteen years, directed residents' practice and helped build Kripalu's original yoga teacher training. He later trained as a Phoenix Rising yoga therapist, became a senior Anusara teacher and trainer, and spent many years studying Tantra with scholars and teachers including Paul Muller-Ortega, Douglas Brooks and Sally Kempton. He is an authorised teacher of Neelakantha meditation in Muller-Ortega's Blue Throat Yoga lineage and is now one of Kripalu's Legacy faculty.

Ashaya Yoga, which he launched in 2012, works with the five elements, light and shadow, and the idea that we are already whole, taught with warmth and a good deal of humour. Todd leads a live online membership with classes on Zoom and a monthly theme, one-to-one spiritual mentoring, meditation initiations, teacher trainings and retreats in the United States and abroad. A trained classical and jazz pianist, he has recorded several albums of music and mantra for practice, among them Bija, and in 2021 he published a memoir, Tantra Yoga: Journey to Unbreakable Wholeness.

books.title: Tantra Yoga: Journey to Unbreakable Wholeness, A Memoir
books.author: Todd Norian
books.description: Todd's memoir of his years in the Kripalu ashram and after, woven together with an introduction to nondual Tantra as a philosophy of the heart rather than the popular sexual caricature. Each chapter pairs a stretch of his story with a Sanskrit teaching and suggestions for practice.

courses.title: New Year’s Yoga Retreat: Awaken Your Heart, Align Your Life
courses.description: A New Year retreat at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, teaching Ashaya Yoga's mix of alignment, breath, mantra and philosophy. Early-morning meditation and pranayama open each day, with time to set direction for the year ahead.

courses.title: Living Tantra: Find Inner Peace in a Tumultuous World
courses.description: A spring weekend at Kripalu working with the five elements of earth, water, fire, air and space through yoga, meditation, breath, mantra and reflection. Tantric teachings are offered as practical ways of meeting change with steadiness and compassion.

courses.title: Ashaya Yoga Online Membership
courses.description: A live online programme of yoga, meditation and community circles on Zoom, built around a monthly theme from yoga and Tantra philosophy. Members also get the on-demand library of past classes and mantra handouts; class packs and drop-ins are offered as well.
courses.price: $99 USD per month or $999 USD per year (14-day trial $14 USD)

courses.title: Initiation into Neelakantha Meditation
courses.description: A two-day online initiation in which Todd gives each student a personal mantra in a one-to-one session, with group teaching and practice either side. It includes eighteen months of follow-up teaching from Blue Throat Yoga, the lineage of Paul Muller-Ortega.

courses.title: Online Spiritual Life Mentoring
courses.description: One-to-one mentoring sessions with Todd for people working through change or questions of purpose on the spiritual path. Sessions are on Zoom or in person at his home studio, singly or in bundles of four.
courses.price: $175 USD per online hour (four for $599 USD); $250 USD in person (four for $899 USD)

courses.title: Yoga in the Azores: Exploring the Five Elements Within
courses.description: Five nights on São Miguel in the Azores with daily yoga led by Todd, guided hikes and time in natural hot springs. Organised by SolSeed Retreats.

courses.title: Ashaya Yoga On-Demand Library
courses.description: Recordings of the last six months of membership classes, available to rent one at a time. Members watch them free.
